import base64, hashlib, hmac, importlib.util, sys
from pathlib import Path

# Import module and ensure function exists
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('shopify_webhook', '/work/shopify_webhook.py')
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
print('has verify_webhook', hasattr(mod, 'verify_webhook'))

fn = mod.verify_webhook

# self-computed vectors
cases = []
for raw, secret in [
    (b'', ''),
    (b'hello', 'shpss_test_secret'),
    (b'{"id":123,"name":"Order"}', 'another_secret'),
    ('ðŸ˜€ bytes utf8'.encode('utf-8'), 's3cr3t'),
]:
    good = base64.b64encode(hmac.new(secret.encode('utf-8'), raw, hashlib.sha256).digest()).decode('ascii')
    cases.append((raw, good, secret, True, 'valid'))
    cases.append((raw, good[:-1] + ('A' if good[-1] != 'A' else 'B'), secret, False, 'invalid mismatch'))

# required false conditions
cases.extend([
    (b'abc', None, 'k', False, 'None header'),
    (b'abc', '', 'k', False, 'empty header'),
    (b'abc', 'Ã¡', 'k', False, 'non-ascii header'),
])

all_ok = True
for i, (raw, header, secret, expected, label) in enumerate(cases, 1):
    try:
        got = fn(raw, header, secret)
    except Exception as e:
        all_ok = False
        print(f'case {i} {label}: EXCEPTION {e!r}')
        continue
    if got != expected:
        all_ok = False
        print(f'case {i} {label}: expected {expected}, got {got}')

print('all_ok', all_ok)
